title: NameQuick managed-proxy conformance vector
description: One scenario per file. Vectors are pure data: no code in this repo decides behavior. Each client implements its own runner that reads `given` fixtures, drives its client code, and asserts the `expect` block.

id.description: Stable unique id, matches the filename stem.

contract_version.description: Contract version this vector targets. 1 = Phase A.

kind.description: wire = fixed request/response bytes and shapes at the HTTP boundary; behavior = required client decision/output given a fixture.

description.description: Optional longer explanation of what the scenario proves.

spec_refs.description: Optional list of spec section anchors this vector exercises.

given.description: Input fixtures: request the client would send and/or response(s) the server returns. Free-form per scenario; documented in vectors/README.md.

expect.description: Required client behavior/output. A conformant client MUST satisfy every assertion here.
